projects.name: High Speed Trading on the Solana Ecosystem
projects.summary: Collaboratively built high speed (approx 0.15 second pull times) pricing api using only blockchain calls for 4 major DEXs on the Solana Ecosystem. Implemented a modified Moore-Bellman-Ford algorithm a the line-graph of currency pairs which spots profitable paths of length up to 12.
